# Inter

Static TTFs used by the default NL UI font embed (`src/FontsFree.cpp`).

- Source: https://github.com/rsms/inter (release v4.1)
- Files: `Inter-Medium.ttf` (regular UI), `Inter-Black.ttf` (titles)
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — see `LICENSE.txt`

Regenerate the embed after replacing TTFs:

```sh
python tools/gen_fonts.py
```
